exact_passages.quote: Proceeds from the loan will be used to complete the development of Nusajaya Tech Park (NTP) Data Center Campus Plot 1 in Johor, Malaysia.
The Phase 1 of the GDS NTP campus covers a total net floor area of 30,312 square meters and boasts an IT power capacity of 69.9 MW.
UOB Malaysia serves as the Sole Coordinator and jointly acts as Green Loan Coordinator with Standard Chartered Bank (Singapore) Limited for this transaction.
with their support, these green loans will fuel our business with green energy (William Huang, Chairman and CEO of GDS — promotional language, not a procurement fact)

its aspiration of becoming the first data center operator to achieve carbon neutrality in this region, with 100% use of renewable energy by 2030 (Tan Ai Chin, MD, OCBC Bank (Malaysia) Berhad — a stated ASPIRATION/target, not current procurement)
notably the utilization of prefabricated infrastructure and liquid-cooling solutions (efficiency measures; not renewable-energy procurement)

per_dimension_assessment.facility_identity: SUPPORTED by IJGlobal + PR Newswire: GDS Nusajaya Tech Park (NTP) Data Center Campus Plot 1 (NTP1), Johor, Malaysia; sponsor GDS Holdings
per_dimension_assessment.phase: SUPPORTED as a label ('Phase 1'/NTP1); what Phase 1 includes physically (which buildings/units) is not specified in any inspected source beyond net floor area 30,312 m2 (PRN)
per_dimension_assessment.loan_amount: SUPPORTED and cross-consistent: total MYR 1,270.00m (USD 272.12m); BoC tranche MYR 317.50m (USD 68.03m) matches the AidData row amount
per_dimension_assessment.green_use_of_proceeds: PARTIAL: 'green' designation asserted by deal participants; stated proceeds purpose = completing Plot 1 development; NO Green Loan Framework, second-party opinion or UoP breakdown among accessible sources — the green credential itself is unverified
per_dimension_assessment.project_status: DISAGREEMENT kept visible: IJGlobal 'Current Stage: Pre-construction' + 'Financial close (8 Dec 2023)' (deal stage) vs AidData 'Completion' (ambiguous: financing completion) vs PRN future-framed delivery; NO inspected source states construction completion; IJGlobal data is dated 10 Dec 2023 (stale at 2026 retrieval)
per_dimension_assessment.renewable_procurement: UNKNOWN / NOT EVIDENCED: only an aspiration quoted by a bank executive ('100% use of renewable energy by 2030') and GDS marketing language; no REC, PPA, on-site generation or supply data in any accessible source
per_dimension_assessment.ai_workloads: NOT INFERABLE: the sources describe a data-centre campus; no tenant, workload or AI-specific information is present — none is inferred

defined_search_universe.dataset: AidData China's Loans and Grants to Low- and Middle-Income Countries, v1.0 (2025-11-18)
defined_search_universe.keyword_regex: data cent(er|re)|datacent|artificial intelligence|\bAI\b (case-SENSITIVE after fix)|machine learning|cloud comput|supercomput|digital econom|5G|hyperscal|semiconductor

cause: \bAI\b with re.I matched the person name 'Yan Ting'ai' (Chinese Ambassador, 2004)
false_positives_found_and_fixed.fix: AI token made case-sensitive via (?-i:...) — record excluded from hits

cause: 'Myanmar Agricultural and Rural Statistics Project Data Center' matches 'data cent' but its subject is a statistics project, not commercial digital/AI infrastructure
false_positives_found_and_fixed.fix: kept in hits (keyword-level true positive) and documented as out-of-scope subject; not silently dropped

known_false_negative_risks: Non-English titles/narratives (dataset is English-only; nothing to scan).
Variants not in the regex: 'AI factory', 'intelligent computing', 'colocation', 'server farm', 'digital infrastructure', 'IDC', 'compute'.
Facilities described only in Staff_Comments or agreement titles (not scanned).
Projects whose data-center relevance appears only in unlinked source documents.
definitional_choices: 5G/4G telecom rollouts are INCLUDED as digital-infrastructure adjacency (policy choice; inflates 'AI infra' counts if read narrowly).
Google Maps/other 'Other'-type sources are not scanned.
scan_audit.limits: The scan identifies financing/announcement records, not facilities; absence of hits is absence within this defined universe only — it does not establish the absence of data-centre or procurement registries anywhere.
